# fastf 3.8.1 — Add a todo, from anywhere

Adding a todo was only the detail pane's last row, so the command palette
could not find it and the action menu did not list it. Both do now.

## Add a todo

Press `c` and type "todo", or open a project's action menu: **Add a todo**
asks for one line and puts it on the selected project's list, the same way
the pane's add row does. The pane's row now runs that very command, so the
two cannot drift apart.

A todo belongs to one list, so with projects marked the command is greyed out
and says to clear the marks first.

Nothing else changed.

Full key list: [docs/cli.md](https://github.com/cristocola/fast-folder/blob/main/docs/cli.md#keys)
